examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A composed platform screen filling the container at the default 800-pixel height. Drag the right edge to change the width, the bottom edge to change the height, or the corner to change both, and watch the grid, the header and the closing band reflow.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import BrowserFrame from '@aziontech/webkit/browser-frame'
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import CallToAction from '@aziontech/webkit/call-to-action'
  import CardGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/card-grid'
  import FeatureItem from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-item'
  import RegistrationFrame from '@aziontech/webkit/registration-frame'
  import SectionContainer from '@aziontech/webkit/section-container'
  import SectionGap from '@aziontech/webkit/section-gap'
  import SectionModule from '@aziontech/webkit/section-module'
  import SectionTitle from '@aziontech/webkit/section-title'
</script>

<template>
  <BrowserFrame
    address="https://www.azion.com"
    aria-label="Azion platform page"
  >
    <SectionContainer max-width="site">
      <SectionGap
        size="small"
        hatch
      />
      <SectionModule
        :divided="false"
        :padded="false"
      >
        <template #header>
          <SectionTitle
            variant="split"
            eyebrow="Platform"
            title="Build, secure and deliver from one platform"
            description="Run your applications, protect them and cache their responses on the same distributed network."
          >
            <template #actions>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                label="See all products"
              />
            </template>
          </SectionTitle>
        </template>
        <RegistrationFrame
          flush
          borders="y"
          marks="all"
        >
          <CardGrid
            flush
            variant="frame"
            :columns="3"
            :mobile-columns="1"
          >
            <CardGrid.Cell variant="canvas">
              <FeatureItem
                :heading-level="3"
                icon="ai ai-edge-application"
                title="Applications"
                description="Deploy web apps and APIs close to every user, with no servers to provision."
              />
            </CardGrid.Cell>
            <CardGrid.Cell variant="canvas">
              <FeatureItem
                :heading-level="3"
                icon="ai ai-edge-firewall"
                title="Firewall"
                description="Stop DDoS, bots and injection attacks before a request reaches your origin."
              />
            </CardGrid.Cell>
            <CardGrid.Cell variant="canvas">
              <FeatureItem
                :heading-level="3"
                icon="ai ai-tiered-cache"
                title="Tiered Cache"
                description="Answer repeat requests from the nearest location and offload your origin."
              />
            </CardGrid.Cell>
          </CardGrid>
        </RegistrationFrame>
      </SectionModule>
      <SectionGap
        size="small"
        hatch
      />
      <SectionModule
        :divided="false"
        :padded="false"
      >
        <CallToAction
          framed
          variant="split"
          eyebrow="Get started"
          title="Deploy your first application."
          title-muted="Run it everywhere."
          description="Start on the free plan and move to production when you are ready. No credit card required."
        >
          <template #actions>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              label="Start for free"
            />
          </template>
          <template #aside>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              label="Talk to a specialist"
            />
          </template>
        </CallToAction>
      </SectionModule>
      <SectionGap
        size="small"
        hatch
      />
    </SectionContainer>
  </BrowserFrame>
</template>
